rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The four identified occurrence records agree with identified_bias_summary: Availability heuristic 2, Anchoring and adjustment 1, and Premature cognitive commitment 1. The separate candidate count is one.

evaluation_limitations: The segment map was supplied frozen and treated as authoritative.
The interview is retrospective self-report without DCS, alarm-log, or independent behavioral records.
The RAG provides purported corpus passages for two occurrences, but the underlying corpus and retrieval logs are absent, so retrieval fidelity cannot be independently verified.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The alarm had fired repeatedly and the pattern in my head felt strong enough on its own, so I treated it as a nuisance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant estimated the likelihood that the alarm was false from easily recalled prior nuisance alarms without checking current corroborating evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was focused on the panel itself because it was the loudest thing in the room and did not pull up the quieter pressure trend until later.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The prominent audible and visual alarm captured attention while a less salient but relevant pressure trend was overlooked.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The recent four hours looked clean, so I took the stable handover at face value and wrote off the older unresolved drift note as old news.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant overweighted the most recent stable report relative to the older unresolved drift evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I ran the standard feed-increase sequence, the same steps I had done about a hundred times, without stopping to reconsider the abnormal precursor.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A highly practiced action sequence was executed automatically without adapting it to the abnormal conditions.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The alarm, temperature climb, and shimmer reminded me of a prior compressor surge, so my instinct was to pull that same response template despite the missing vibration signature.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A superficially similar prior event was used as the diagnostic template despite the absence of a defining feature.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The tube-rupture incident felt like the more likely explanation because it was dramatic and people brought it up in every shift briefing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The likelihood of a rare failure mode was increased because the memorable incident was socially and mentally available.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went with the first checklist option that looked workable and did not compare it with the rest because I needed something fast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Under a closing time window, the participant selected the first adequate option rather than evaluating all alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The selected action stabilized the immediate trend, but a later review found another checklist step that would have addressed the underlying issue better.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive retrospective outcome assessment without an intentionally embedded hidden bias instance.

instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The cited statements are verbatim, directly support automatic performance, and acknowledge the abnormal alarm and drift note.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: vivid tube-rupture likelihood judgment
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: The likelihood of a rare tube-rupture cause is inflated because a vivid, dramatic, frequently discussed incident is readily recalled despite absent current markers.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is an established alternate name for Availability Bias; the RAG explicitly links judged likelihood to repeated discussion and vivid recall.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 4: time-constrained checklist option selection
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Under time and cognitive constraints, the operator satisficies by taking the first workable checklist action instead of comparing all alternatives.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring and adjustment is a neighboring but distinct account of option search and is not an approved equivalent for Bounded Rationality.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate's proposed first-option anchor shares the limited-search consequence, but attributes it to anchoring rather than resource-constrained satisficing; the interview instead explicitly cites time pressure and a workable-enough option.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The candidate quotation is verbatim and localized correctly. Its stated mechanism is plausible but not a full match for the hidden resource-constrained satisficing mechanism.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The quote is valid and in the correct handover segment, but anchoring is not an approved Recency Bias alias and the stated stable-report anchor mechanism does not fully capture temporal overweighting.

The evidence fully captures an automatic, repeatedly practiced routine that was not adapted to abnormal cues, so it is a mechanism-first hit; Premature cognitive commitment is related to but not an approved established synonym for Habit Intrusion, so strict scoring counts a false positive and leaves the hidden instance missed.

The candidate is correctly located and quotes the first-workable-option choice, but its proposed anchoring explanation is not the hidden resource-constrained satisficing mechanism and is not an equivalent label.

candidates.details: The exact checklist quote is correctly localized and is related to the hidden satisficing episode, but the proposed first-option anchoring mechanism is only a partial overlap with resource-constrained Bounded Rationality. It improves segment-level detection only.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3/7 positive reasoning segments are detected, with 4 misses and no false alarms (segment F1 0.6000).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 2/7 hidden instances are exact label-plus-mechanism hits (precision 0.6667, recall 0.2857, F1 0.4000); availability is detected twice, while the remaining targets are missed.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, the same availability findings plus the automatic routine-action finding yield 3/7 mechanism-first hits (precision 1.0000, recall 0.4286, F1 0.6000). The routine-action label remains a strict false positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate correctly localizes the checklist episode and raises segment recall at the fourth threshold, but its stated anchoring mechanism is only a partial match to bounded-rationality satisficing. It adds an instance-level false positive and no true positive.
main_failure_modes: No salience finding for overlooking the quieter pressure trend.
The handover prediction is a recency near miss labeled as anchoring and adjustment, with only partial mechanism overlap.
The automatic routine behavior is correctly described but labeled as premature cognitive commitment rather than an approved Habit Intrusion equivalent, so it earns only mechanism-first credit.
A single availability finding combines the diagnostic phase and cannot also count as a separate similarity-bias detection under one-to-one matching.
No identified finding covers bounded-rationality satisficing; the candidate has only a partial anchoring explanation.
main_strengths: Both availability instances are correctly identified with full mechanisms and valid quotations.
The routine feed-increase behavior is localized correctly and its automatic, practiced-action mechanism is fully captured.
All supplied quotations are valid; the identified occurrence summary agrees with the detailed records.
The low-confidence and candidate tiers are scored separately, preserving the first three threshold results.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong quote fidelity and partial mechanism coverage, but modest hidden-instance recall. Taxonomy mapping loses one full behavioral-mechanism hit under strict scoring, while the low-confidence anchoring near miss and the candidate add false positives without instance-level gains.
